end_to_end_note: Creation to final decision, including human waiting time; pending workflows have no completion duration.

handoff_success_rate.definition: Completed AI stages / started AI stages; includes pending and interrupted starts

human_approval_rate.definition: Accepted or partially accepted workflows / tracked workflows

plan_acceptance_rate.reason: No separate plan-approval decision is recorded.

plan_generation_rate.definition: Runs producing a plan / runs started

reviewer_defect_yield.note: Reported issues are not confirmed defects. Ground-truth regression results are separate.

rework_ratio.definition: Repeat runs / all runs; includes failure retries

scope: Local development history, including failures and interrupted runs; not a benchmark.

workflow_completion_rate.definition: Workflows with a final human decision / tracked workflows; rejection counts as closed
